att2.assist.conscience.1: The Conscience can provide a large amount of game information and basic game settings, as well as some convenient shortcut functions.
att2.assist.conscience.2: The <Player Info> page of the Conscience allows you to view the character name, title, player level, maximum Dahäl, maximum health, temperature value and other information.
att2.assist.conscience.3: The <Player Attributes> page of the Conscience allows you to view current attribute values or perform attribute point allocation.
att2.assist.conscience.4: The <Currency Info> page of the Conscience allows you to view the current amount of Chronotons, Sovereign Chaos Scales and Rune Powder, and you can discard Chronotons to share with other players.
att2.assist.conscience.5: The <Map Settings> page of the Conscience allows you to adjust various basic game settings, including <Game Difficulty>, <Monster Health Bars>, <Player Attributes>, <Game Language> and other settings.
att2.assist.conscience.6: The <Other Info> page of the Conscience allows you to view various game records you have made on the map.
att2.assist.conscience.7: The <Main/Side Quests> shortcut of the Conscience allows you to view current main quest progress and obtain certain hints and guidance.
att2.assist.conscience.8: The <Daily Quests> shortcut of the Conscience allows you to view accepted <Daily Quests> and their progress.
att2.assist.conscience.9: The <Gather Items> shortcut of the Conscience can gather nearby dropped items and experience orbs together, and the maximum number of uses will increase as Time/Space Gems are obtained (2-minute cooldown).
att2.assist.conscience.10: The <Horse Whistle> shortcut of the Conscience can quickly summon/retrieve your mount.
att2.assist.conscience.11: The <Quick Repair> shortcut of the Conscience can display the durability percentage of current equipment and allow quick repair using repair tools.
att2.assist.conscience.12: The <Respawn Point> shortcut of the Conscience can return you to your last recorded respawn location for 100 Chronotons.
att2.assist.conscience.13: The <Quick Equipment Swap> shortcut of the Conscience can quickly replace the armor you are wearing.
att2.assist.conscience.14: The <Game Guide> page of the Conscience can display the locations of nearby NPCs and teleport gates.
att2.assist.conscience.15: Holding the Conscience and pressing the <Sneak Key> can summon the <Stock>. You can unlock higher tiers of the <Stock> by obtaining Time Gems, Runes, visiting the Black Market, or consulting the Dahäl Master.
att2.assist.shop.16: <Chronotons> is the main currency of this world, and players can buy various items from merchants in various towns.
att2.assist.shop.17: <Sovereign Chaos Scales> is a rare special currency. Players can buy <Sovereign> equipment, <Recycle Spells> and <Small Pockets> from black market merchants in Ryliath and Eolorion, and also exchange materials or perform enchantments in the <Rune Chamber> or <Enchantment Chamber>.
att2.assist.shop.18: At the <Recycle Merchant>, you can sell unwanted items. The higher the item quality, the higher the selling price and the more accumulated recycling experience.
att2.assist.shop.19: <Blacksmiths> and <Potion Merchants> sell most items in the game <randomly>. The higher the item quality, the lower the appearance probability. Players can refresh the shop using the <Force Refresh> sign below the merchant; the natural refresh time is <30 minutes>.
att2.assist.shop.20: At Charles' Casino in the Soquai Forest, players can spend a certain amount of Chronotons to place bets or unlock treasure grids to obtain rich rewards.
att2.assist.shop.21: Fishermen in each city sell some <Fishing Gear>. You can <Fish> in various parts of the Sylberland Continent to obtain additional loot.
att2.assist.shop.22: The NPC Estelle near the gate of Ryliath sells miscellaneous items such as <Small Chairs>, <Sylberland Maps>, <Torches> and so on.
att2.assist.shop.23: Cities on the Sylberland Continent have NPCs that sell mounts such as <Horses>, <Mules>, <Boars>, <Camels> and so on.
att2.assist.shop.24: Repairing equipment or buying weapons and armor at the <Blacksmith> will increase <Blacksmith Level>. The higher the Blacksmith Level, the more durability restored to items and the more items sold by the blacksmith.
att2.assist.shop.25: Chronotons come in six types with different denominations: <Small Coin>: 1, <Big Coin>: 5, <Diamond>: 50, <Amethyst>: 500, <Ruby>: 1000.
att2.assist.shop.26: The <7777 Bet> in Charles' Casino has a chance to obtain items from the <Angband>, <Billgart> and <Ouranos> dimensions.
att2.assist.travel.27: <Waypoint> allow you to move quickly between two locations, but you must unlock them first to use them.
att2.assist.travel.28: The <Sylberland Map> records waypoints across the Sylberland Continent, but you need to <progress the main quest> and <accept sub quests> to unlock more regions and waypoints. Click a waypoint on the map with a mount to <automatically travel to the destination>.
att2.assist.difficult.29: Upon <Death>, players return to their last recorded respawn point and lose some <Chronotons>, <Experience> and <Saturation>. The higher the <Difficulty>, the more severe the penalty.
att2.assist.difficult.30: There are four game difficulties: <Apprentice>, <Veteran>, <Master>, <Nightmare>. The higher the difficulty, the higher the attack, health and movement speed of monsters, and the experience and rewards obtained from killing monsters will also be increased to a certain extent.
att2.assist.difficult.31: On <Nightmare> difficulty, players lose half their Chronotons, all saturation and a large amount of experience upon each death. Monster spawn rate, health, movement speed, resistance and attack power are also greatly increased.
att2.assist.difficult.32: Monsters are divided into <Normal Monster>, <Normal Elite>, <Mutated Elite>, <Super Elite>, <Ultimate Elite>. Super Elites and Ultimate Elites have additional boosts to size, movement speed, attack power and damage reduction, and defeating special elite monsters grants extra rewards.
att2.assist.difficult.33: The color of a monster's health bar represents its level.For normal monsters: Green, Dark Green, Yellow, Dark Yellow, Red, Dark Red.For elites: Normal Elite -> Blue, Super Elite -> Dark Blue, Ultimate Elite -> Dark Cyan.
att2.assist.difficult.34: Monsters in the <Billgart> dimension have stronger resistance to projectiles.Monsters in the <Ouranos> dimension have stronger resistance to fire damage.
att2.assist.difficult.35:
<Normal Elites> have a certain chance to undergo <Ability Mutation>, possessing unique special abilities:
<Attribute Mutation>:<Strength Type>: Very high attack power but relatively low health.<Speed Type>: Very fast movement speed but very low attack power.<Health Type>: Very high health but very slow movement speed.
<Death Mutation>:<Curse Type>: Inflicts negative mental effects on nearby players upon death.<Heal Type>: Restores 50% maximum health to nearby monsters upon death.<Fortify Type>: Grants 5 seconds of invulnerability to nearby monsters upon death.
<Immunity Mutation>:<Attack Immunity>: Gains invulnerability when players are within 5 blocks.<Arrow Immunity>: Destroys player-fired arrows within 5 blocks.<Magic Immunity>: Immune to all damaging Dahäl spells.
att2.assist.item.36: Nearly 1000 items of different qualities can be obtained from monster drops, chests, merchants, main quests and sub quests: <Quest Item>, <Common>, <Uncommon>, <Rare>, <Sovereign>, <Epic>, <Legendary>, <Ultimate>, <Mythic>.
att2.assist.item.37: There are six types of weapons with different attack speeds and base damage: <Dagger>, <Sword>, <Axe>, <Spear>, <Hammer>, <Scythe>.
att2.assist.item.38: There are six different weapon qualities, each with unique special attributes and durability values: <Wood>, <Stone>, <Iron>, <Copper>, <Gold>, <Diamond>, <Netherite>.
att2.assist.item.39: Gold equipment obtained in the Angband dimension restores a small amount of durability at regular intervals.
att2.assist.item.40: After drinking a potion, the player gains temporary attribute bonuses, but their duration does not stack. Each drink overwrites the same attribute effect while retaining different ones.
att2.assist.item.41: There are 15 sets of Epic and Legendary quality gear sets, which can be distinguished by the <Set Bonus> text below them. Equipping a full set grants additional attribute bonuses.
att2.assist.item.42: After breaking the arena gate outside Asunark Island, you can buy <Otaurian Armor> from the NPC <Homer> around the island, which allows you to move more durably and quickly underwater.
att2.assist.item.43: <Daggers> have faster attack speed, lower attack power and shorter attack range, with very high critical strike effectiveness.
att2.assist.item.44: <Swords> have more balanced attack speed and attack power, with more balanced critical strike effectiveness.
att2.assist.item.45: <Axes> have lower attack speed and higher attack power, with low critical strike effectiveness. Holding an axe, press <F (Swap Item Key)> to throw it and damage enemies.
att2.assist.item.46: <Spears> have very low attack speed and high attack power, with low critical strike effectiveness. When attacking with a spear, pay attention to the distance from enemies. Maintaining a proper distance deals higher damage, otherwise lower damage.
att2.assist.item.47: <Hammers> have extremely low attack speed and very high attack power, with very low critical strike effectiveness. Jump attacking with a <Hammer> can knock enemies back slightly, while also recoiling the user.
att2.assist.item.48: <Scythes> have lower attack speed and higher attack power, with low critical strike effectiveness. Holding a scythe reveals enemy weak points. Striking weak points deals massive damage, otherwise lower damage.
att2.assist.item.49: When <Shield> is right-clicked to block, holding a weapon and pressing Sneak puts the shield on cooldown and releases various melee skills.
att2.assist.item.50: Attacking with different weapons accumulates a certain amount of Fatigue. The higher the Fatigue, the more attack speed is reduced. Therefore, pay attention to attack rhythm during combat and avoid swinging wildly.
att2.assist.item.51: Bow and crossbow damage is related to your current <Strength> attribute and <Power Enchantment Level>.
att2.assist.item.52: There are several types of <Rune Arrows> that can be crafted from arrows in the Rune Chamber of Ryliath.
att2.assist.attribute.53: Nine <Attributes> affect player stats: <Strength>, <Critical>, <Resistance>, <Attack Speed>, <Movement Speed>, <Luck>, <Hunger Resistance>, <Health Regeneration>, <Dahäl Regeneration>.
att2.assist.attribute.54: <Strength> increases or reduces melee or ranged weapon damage. For melee weapons, Strength provides a percentage boost to base attack damage.
att2.assist.attribute.55: <Critical> increases critical strike chance and damage for melee, ranged and spell attacks. Different weapons/spells have different critical strike effectiveness.
att2.assist.attribute.56: <Resistance>: Each point grants 5% damage reduction and 3 flat damage reduction.
att2.assist.attribute.57: <Attack Speed>: Each point increases or reduces attack speed by 10%.
att2.assist.attribute.58: <Movement Speed>: Each point increases or reduces movement speed by 10%.
att2.assist.attribute.59: <Luck> increases or reduces rewards from monsters, chests, fishing and bosses.
att2.assist.attribute.60: <Hunger Resistance> increases the strength of saturation effects and shortens their cycle. Low values cause hunger effects.
att2.assist.attribute.61: <Health Regeneration>: Each point increases or reduces health recovery by 0.05 per second. Negative values cause health loss.
att2.assist.attribute.62: <Dahäl Regeneration> increases Dahäl recovery per second.
att2.assist.attribute.63: Wearing equipment, allocating attributes, casting spells, drinking potions and special enchantments all increase or reduce your attributes.
att2.assist.attribute.64: Each Time Gem placed grants 5 <Ability Points>.
att2.assist.attribute.65: You can reset your <Ability Points> at the <Ability Master> in Ryliath. The higher your level, the more Chronotons required to reset (maximum 500 Chronotons).
att2.assist.reputation.66: There are more than 150 NPCs in various dimensions and regions.
att2.assist.reputation.67: Right-click NPCs to talk to them. Some NPCs with a <!> above their heads may need your help.
att2.assist.reputation.68: Talking to all NPCs in a region increases player Reputation Points.
att2.assist.reputation.69: <Reputation Points> affect your current <Title> to a certain extent.
att2.assist.reputation.70: <Reputation Points> affect shop discounts, increase the probability of high-quality items appearing, and also affect the refresh and acceptance of <Daily Quests>.
att2.assist.quest.71: As the <Main Quest> progresses and <Reputation Points> increase, some NPCs will offer new quests.
att2.assist.quest.72: Some side quests require you to provide special items, usually by standing on a <Golden Pressure Plate> to deliver them.
att2.assist.quest.73: The side quest <Ultimate Challenge> unlocks after completing 59 side quests. Completing its <Parkour> and <Arena> challenges grants massive rewards.
att2.assist.quest.74: There are three types of keys: <Small Key>, <Big Key>, <Emerald Key>, obtained during main and sub quests. Hold the key and right-click locks to open certain locked doors.
att2.assist.exploit.75: As main and side quests progress, players can unlock regions and waypoints on the <Sylberland Map>.
att2.assist.exploit.76: The <Sylberland Map> must be used on the main continent. Select the corresponding <Waypoint> to automatically travel to the destination with a mount.
att2.assist.exploit.77: In various dimensions and regions, there are many <Symbol>, <CheckPoint>, <Panorama> and <Secrets> waiting to be discovered.
att2.assist.exploit.78: There are more than 2000 <Achievements> waiting to be completed. Completing <Achievements> rewards <Exploration Points>. Current maximum obtainable <Exploration Points>: %s/%s.
att2.assist.exploit.79: Completing achievements grants <Exploration Points> and <Experience>. Every 150 <Exploration Points> can be exchanged for massive rewards at the Exploration Point Warehouse behind NPC <Writh_Razgork> in Ryliath.
att2.assist.exploit.80: There are more than 1300 <Symbol> scattered across dimensions; triggering them grants Chronotons and experience.
att2.assist.exploit.81: There are more than 90 <Hidden Shulker Boxes> scattered across dimensions, disguised as various blocks with richer loot, usually along the main paths of <Main Quests> and <Sub Quests>.
att2.assist.exploit.82: There are many <Cracked Walls> across dimensions. Players must unlock the <Earthquake Synergy> ability during the main quest in the <Billgart Dimension> to use the <Earthquake> spell to shatter them.
att2.assist.exploit.83: There are many <Frozen Treasures> scattered across the Sylberland Continent. Players must unlock <Fire Synergy> in the <Vonaheim Dungeon> to use <Fire Spells> to melt the ice.
att2.assist.exploit.84: You can obtain an <Exploration Log> from NPC <Wirth_Razgork> in Ryliath, which records your various exploration progress data.
att2.assist.exploit.85: In the temple of the village of Kortaek, there is a mysterious teleport location leading through winding mazes filled with many monsters, trial chests and rune chests. An item called <Ghostfire Glimmer> can be obtained from various maze events and used to mark the maze path.
att2.assist.exploit.86: There are more than 400 <Check Point> scattered across dimensions. Activating all respawn points in each area unlocks an achievement.
att2.assist.exploit.87: Some <Hidden Achievements> are extremely difficult to complete, but they generally do not increase <Exploration Points>.
att2.assist.exploit.88: There are four mansions on the Sylberland Continent waiting to be unlocked, usually requiring certain main quest progress or sub quest completion.
att2.assist.exploit.89: After unlocking a house, you can spend Chronotons for <House Expansion>, which unlocks a large number of <Storage Chests>, <Cake>, and allows teleportation between houses via the <Teleport Room> inside.
att2.assist.exploit.90: About 5,000 chests are scattered across various dimensions. Chests containing loot will remain marked as opened once unlocked. If a high‑rarity item appears when opening a chest, it is usually accompanied by special sound effects and additional particle effects.
att2.assist.exploit.91: <Decorated Pot> can be found on the Telluron Continent. Players can destroy it by right-clicking or jumping on top of it, and it will drop items such as Chronotons, Rune Materials, Sovereign Chaos Scales, etc.
att2.assist.random_event.92: <Lost Souls> spawn randomly on the Sylberland Continent. Catching them grants massive experience, a small amount of Chronotons, and rewards increase as player level rises.
att2.assist.random_event.93: <Monster Hordes> spawn randomly in various dimensions, usually accompanied by loud thunder and red glowing markers. Monster Hordes spawn <Rune Chests>, <Mimics> and <Large numbers of monsters>.
att2.assist.random_event.94: <Mimic> have a chance to spawn nearby when opening a new chest, accompanied by sound cues. Mimics do not attack players unprovoked. Attacking a mimic triggers random events, and killing it grants massive rewards.
att2.assist.random_event.95: <Block Mimic> spawn randomly in various dimensions, mimicking nearby blocks and sleeping. Melee attacks wake them up, but they may flee or attack. Attacking/killing Block Block Mimic massive rewards.
att2.assist.runes.96: There are 27 types of <Rune Materials> obtainable by <killing monsters>, <opening chests>, <crafting> etc. They have different rarities; higher rarity means lower acquisition probability.
att2.assist.runes.97: In the <Rune Chamber> of Ryliath, you can craft various recipes to obtain <Experience>, <ESC>, <Runewords>, <High-Tier Rune Materials>, <Rune Arrows> and more.
att2.assist.runes.98: <Runewords> crafted from <Rune Materials> can be placed on stands in the <Rune Chamber> for activation, granting players extra effects: <Monster Experience>, <Chronotons Boost>, <Spell Experience>, <Spell Cooldown Speed>, <Maximum Dahäl>, <Maximum Health>, <Potion Attribute Duration>, <Boss Rewards>.
att2.assist.runes.99: Left-click the Rune Core in the <Rune Chamber> to switch between rune crafting and rune grinding; right-click to quickly view all recipes.
att2.assist.runes.100: <Rune Materials> can be ground into <Rune Powder> at the <Rune Chamber> in Ryliath or the underground grinder in Eolorion. It can be used to increase damage of damaging spells at the Archmage of Eolorion Academy, or for special enchantments in the <Enchantment Chamber>.
att2.assist.runes.101: Crafting a <Rune Material> requires unlocking the material itself or its adjacent tiers via Rune Powder.
att2.assist.runes.102: There are 20 types of <Runewords> craftable via recipes, but only 10 can be active at once. Runewords have level requirements, and identical <Runewords> cannot be activated repeatedly.
att2.assist.runes.103: Rumors say that deep in the Black Forest of the Sylberland Continent lies a huge hidden dungeon, seemingly accessible only to those who understand ancient runic secrets.
att2.assist.runes.104: Many <Rune Ores> are hidden across the Sylberland Continent. Right-click to mine <Rune Ores> for random Rune Materials.
att2.assist.runes.105: <Potion Duration Boost> from <Runewords Bonuses> increases positive attribute duration and reduces negative attribute duration slightly.
att2.assist.runes.106: <Chronotons Boost> from <Runewords Bonuses> only applies to Chronotons obtained from <monsters>, <chests>, <boss rewards> and other sources.
att2.assist.runes.107: The <Rune Pouch> automatically collects <Rune Materials> from your inventory into the pouch. Right-click to drop all collected runes.
att2.assist.gameplay.108: <Shields> can block various melee and ranged attacks, but cannot be held up for long. Enemies holding axes can break your blocking stance.
att2.assist.gameplay.109: <Mounts> allow fast travel across the world. More expensive mounts are faster and have more health, but none can jump higher obstacles. They can also be used with the <Sylberland Map> to automatically travel to certain destinations.
att2.assist.gameplay.110: <Bows> and <Crossbows> avoid the risks of close combat, so you can try to shoot enemies from a distance.
att2.assist.gameplay.111: <Small Pockets> bought from black market merchants can hold multiple <Rune Materials>, <Dahäl Launcher> and other items at the same time.
att2.assist.gameplay.112: Different potion attributes do not interfere with each other, while identical attributes overwrite each other. You can combine different potions to temporarily boost your abilities.
att2.assist.gameplay.113: <Strength> provides great help when you are in desperate situations.
att2.assist.gameplay.114: Summons from <Wolf>, <Bait> and <Golem> greatly reduce combat pressure.
att2.assist.gameplay.115: When health is too low, movement speed and attack speed are greatly reduced.
att2.assist.gameplay.116: When holding non-melee weapons, player melee damage is greatly reduced.
att2.assist.gameplay.117: The longer the player survives, the more experience gained from killing monsters, up to <double experience>. This bonus resets upon death.
att2.assist.gameplay.118: Killing monsters continuously in a short time triggers <COMBO> rewards. The more monsters killed in a chain, the more experience gained.
att2.assist.gameplay.119: When blocked by difficulties in main or sub quests, you can try using <Main Quest> and <Side Quest> hints, which usually provide important quest node information, though you must determine the specific route yourself.
att2.assist.gameplay.120: When saturation is below half, a Strength penalty is applied. When saturation is full, extra Strength and Health Regeneration are granted. This effect weakens as game difficulty increases.
att2.assist.dahal.121: There are more than 30 Dahäl spells divided into <Destruction>, <Summon>, <Alteration>. Most can be bought from the Dahäl Master; a few require completing certain sub quests, special challenges or crafting.
att2.assist.dahal.122: Most Dahäl spells have 10 levels. Higher levels strengthen spell effects.
att2.assist.dahal.123: To cast a Dahäl spell, open the spell book, select the level to cast, then automatically switch to Launcher form. Simply right-click to cast.
att2.assist.dahal.124: <Spell Experience> gained from casting spells is related to <current player level>, <selected spell level> and <Runewords Spell Experience Boost>.
att2.assist.dahal.125: The Dahäl Spell Book displays relevant spell descriptions. Throwing the spell book or catalyst refreshes spell data. Clicking a <Spell Name> in the book shows data for unlocked spell levels.
att2.assist.dahal.126: Dahäl spell cooldown is related to <Spell Level>, <Runewords Cooldown Boost> and <Enchantment Effects>.
att2.assist.dahal.127: The <Stock> storage spell gains one tier each time a Time Gem is obtained. Its <Previous Page>, <Next Page> and <Drop All> functions allow quick browsing or discarding of items.
att2.assist.dahal.128: Offensive spells have a chance to crit. Different spells have different critical strike effectiveness.
att2.assist.dahal.129: Destruction spell <Fireball>: Launches a fire projectile that deals explosive damage to nearby enemies in an area.
att2.assist.dahal.130: Destruction spell <Fireline>: Fires a flame forward, damaging and igniting enemies along the way while slightly reducing their attack power.
att2.assist.dahal.131: Destruction spell <Inferno>: Unleashes a fierce flame aura that damages and ignites nearby enemies.
att2.assist.dahal.132: Destruction spell <Power Ray>: Fires pure Dahäl energy, dealing massive damage to enemies along the path.
att2.assist.dahal.133: Destruction spell <Thunderstruck>: Calls continuous lightning strikes to a target location.
att2.assist.dahal.134: Destruction spell <Explosion Trap>: Creates a temporary trap that deals explosive damage to nearby enemies when they approach.
att2.assist.dahal.135: Destruction spell <Geyser>: Generates a violently erupting spring underfoot, launching enemies in range into the air and granting brief fire resistance to nearby players.
att2.assist.dahal.136: Destruction spell <Swarm Arrow>: Summons a large number of fire arrows above, dealing fierce damage to nearby enemies.
att2.assist.dahal.137: Destruction spell <Tiid Klo Ul>: Greatly reduces attack power and movement speed of nearby enemies for its duration.
att2.assist.dahal.138: Destruction spell <Earthquake>: Generates continuous seismic waves underfoot, dealing continuous damage to nearby enemies and slightly reducing their movement speed.
att2.assist.dahal.139: Destruction spell <Nova>: Continuously damages nearby enemies, slightly reduces their movement speed, and grants the player Night Vision.
att2.assist.dahal.140: Destruction spell <Luminous Orb>: Summons a permanent glowing orb that continuously damages nearby enemies.
att2.assist.dahal.141: Summon spell <Healing Companion>: Provides the player with extra <Health Regeneration>.
att2.assist.dahal.142: Summon spell <Dahäl Companion>: Provides the player with extra <Dahäl Regeneration>.
att2.assist.dahal.143: Summon spell <Swift Companion>: Provides the player with extra <Movement Speed>.
att2.assist.dahal.144: Summon spell <Decoy>: Creates a snow golem to draw enemy fire.
att2.assist.dahal.145: Summon spell <Wolf>: Summons wolves that prioritize attacking the nearest enemy.
att2.assist.dahal.146: Summon spell <Golem>: Summons an iron golem that prioritizes attacking the nearest enemy.
att2.assist.dahal.147: Summon spell <Spectral Axe>: Creates an axe from Dahäl, whose attack damage drops by 20% every 10 hits.
att2.assist.dahal.148: Summon spell <Spectral Bow>: Creates a bow from Dahäl, whose Power enchantment drops by one level every 4 hits.
att2.assist.dahal.149: Summon spell <Recycler>: Summons a black hole that converts nearby items into massive experience orbs.
att2.assist.dahal.150: Summon spell <Gold Devourer>: Allows the player to continuously convert nearby items on the ground into Chronotons and experience.
att2.assist.dahal.151: Summon spell <Spatial Teleport>: Creates two teleport points for fast travel between any two points.
att2.assist.dahal.152: Summon spell <Seek Secrets>: Generates glowing markers of various colors to reveal secrets around the world.
att2.assist.dahal.153: Summon spell <Battle Companion>: Summons a battle sprite. Left-click it with a <Sword> to change its weapon.
att2.assist.dahal.154: Summon spell <Soul Companion>: Summons a protective wisp. Left-click to enter <Soul Resonance>, during which you can possess the <Soul Ally> and fly freely. Press Space to interact with nearby chests, glowing spots and rune ores; loot is sent to your main body.
att2.assist.dahal.155: Transform spell <Corruption>: Greatly increases player Strength, Movement Speed, Attack Speed and Health Regeneration.
att2.assist.dahal.156: Transform spell <Regeneration>: Greatly increases player Health Regeneration for a short time.
att2.assist.dahal.157: Transform spell <Healing>: Quickly restores player health and provides brief Defense.
att2.assist.dahal.158: Transform spell <Absorption>: Grants the player extra temporary health.
att2.assist.dahal.159: Transform spell <Elusive>: Grants extra Attack Speed and Movement Speed, and turns the player invisible.
att2.assist.dahal.160: Transform spell <Berserker>: Grants extra Strength but slightly reduces Health Regeneration.
att2.assist.dahal.161: Transform spell <Blood Transmutation>: Sacrifices maximum health to greatly increase maximum Dahäl and slightly boost Dahäl Regeneration for a long time.
att2.assist.dahal.162: <Corruption> and <Nova> cannot be activated at the same time. Using other Destruction spells while either is active greatly reduces their damage.
att2.assist.leveling.163: Killing monsters, unlocking achievements, crafting, completing sub quests and other sources grant massive experience rewards.
att2.assist.leveling.164: Player levels are divided into three types: <Normal Level>, <Master Level>, <Eternal Level>. Leveling fully restores health and Dahäl.
att2.assist.leveling.165: <Normal Level> (max 50): Each level grants extra <Maximum Dahäl>, <Maximum Health> and 3 Ability Points.
att2.assist.leveling.166: After reaching level 50, players unlock <Master Level> (max 300). Each level grants only 2 Ability Points.
att2.assist.leveling.167: After reaching Master Level 300, players unlock <Eternal Level>, which has no level cap and grants only 1 Ability Point per level.
att2.assist.leveling.168: Player Normal Level affects monster level. Higher player level increases monster level, health and attack power. Monster scaling stops at player level 50.
att2.assist.leveling.169: When players reach Master Level, monsters gain extra temporary health. When monster health drops below 50%, they gain brief high resistance, slowed movement and minor healing.
att2.assist.boss.170: Most <BOSSes> can respawn repeatedly. Defeating a BOSS quickly grants extra <ESC Rewards> and <Rune Rewards>, as well as a <BOSS Speed Kill Achievement>.
att2.assist.boss.171: <Umbra'Tyanth> is an extremely powerful enemy. Defeating it grants massive cross-dimensional equipment rewards.
att2.assist.boss.172: When facing the <King of Ouranos>, you can choose to speak peacefully to avoid combat.
att2.assist.legendary.173: There are 14 Mythic items: spells, armor, shields, weapons and more, obtainable via sub quests and hidden quests.
att2.assist.legendary.174: Each Mythic item is unbreakable and has unique abilities that consume a certain amount of Dahäl when used.
att2.assist.legendary.175: Mythic item <Aveugle rempart> (Shield): Right-click to block and move using movement keys to gain Blindness. Movement becomes more uncontrollable while dealing massive damage to enemies along the path.
att2.assist.legendary.176: Mythic item <Blutfresser> (Sword): Heals the player based on attack damage when hitting enemies. Hold right-click to consume health and fire a highly penetrating sword beam.
att2.assist.legendary.177: Mythic item <Fenrir> (Sword): Applies a freezing effect to immobilize enemies upon hit. Hold right-click to create an ice aura that freezes and continuously damages enemies inside, while destroying all enemy projectiles. The wielder is immune to cold effects.
att2.assist.legendary.178: Mythic item <Fortuity> (Sword): Spawns experience orbs when hitting enemies. Every three kills grant brief extra Luck. Base attack damage and speed increase with the player's current Normal Level.
att2.assist.legendary.179: Mythic item <Rukyrion> (Sword): Deals heavy AoE damage to nearby enemies when attacking continuously. Killing an enemy temporarily boosts Strength, Attack Speed and Movement Speed. Tap right-click to fire a sword beam and dash forward to knock up enemies, dealing massive damage.
att2.assist.legendary.180: Mythic item <Ultima> (Sword): Summons up to eight phantom swords. Left-click to make them attack forward and fire piercing lasers. Phantom swords disappear after multiple attacks and refresh over time. Their damage increases with your Exploration Points.
att2.assist.legendary.181: Mythic item <Sastr> (Hammer): Left-click attacks knock enemies far back. If enemies hit a wall or other monsters during knockback, they take extra impact damage and knock the user back.
att2.assist.legendary.182: Mythic item <Lone Shadow> (Dagger): Hold right-click to fade into darkness, temporarily greatly increasing Attack Speed and Movement Speed while accumulating damage. Finally, deal explosive damage to nearby enemies based on total accumulated damage.
att2.assist.legendary.183: Mythic item <Kinuil> (Axe): Hold right-click to create a fire aura and randomly apply soul marks to nearby enemies. Attacking marked enemies deals random AoE damage to nearby foes. The wielder is immune to overheating in high-temperature areas.
att2.assist.legendary.184: Mythic item <Warlord> (Bow): Creates a circular lightning aura upon hitting enemies, pulling enemies in the range to the center and dealing continuous lightning damage.
att2.assist.legendary.185: Mythic item <Invid_Yoyel> (Bow): Adds extra damage to arrows. The farther arrows travel, the higher the damage. Hold right-click to charge longer; longer charge increases arrow penetration.
att2.assist.legendary.186: Mythic item <Practicable_Interfacer> (Gun): A very powerful weapon that fires multiple incendiary rounds per shot, but requires a magazine in the off-hand.
att2.assist.legendary.187: Mythic item <Chargeur_modifie> (Infinite Magazine): Used with <Practicable_Interfacer>. Place the magazine in the off-hand; reloading consumes a certain amount of Dahäl.
att2.assist.legendary.188: Mythic item <Hermes> (Armor Set): Grants +1 to all attributes. Attacking enemies triggers extra AoE damage based on current Chronotons.
att2.assist.legendary.189: Mythic item <WeaponsKing> (Spear): Basic attacks generate Chronotons based on damage dealt.On <Land>: Right-click to throw the spear. Teleport to the enemy upon hit and deal extra damage to nearby enemies.In <Water>: Hold right-click to dash forward, dealing extra damage and knocking up enemies along the way.
att2.assist.legendary.190: Mythic item <ElixirVitae> (Potion): Grants +1 to all attributes (except RES) for 1 hour.
att2.assist.legendary.191: Mythic item <Seek Secrets> (Spell): Has a unique ability to uncover all hidden secrets in each region.
att2.assist.enchantment.192: Universal Enchantment <Auto Repair>: Automatically uses repair tools when durability falls below (10%/20%/30%).
att2.assist.enchantment.193: Universal Enchantment <Reinforce>: Increases maximum durability by (5%/10%/15%/20%/25%).
att2.assist.enchantment.194: Universal Enchantment <Rune Hardening>: Fixed reduction of (1/2/3) armor durability loss (armor only).
att2.assist.enchantment.195: Bow Exclusive Enchantment <Anchored Shot>: Increases bow damage by (10%/20%/30%/40%/50%) but prevents movement while drawing.
att2.assist.enchantment.196: Bow Exclusive Enchantment <Headhunter>: Fully charged arrows to the head deal (10%/20%/30%/40%/50%) extra damage.
att2.assist.enchantment.197: Crossbow Exclusive Enchantment <Precision Shot>: Makes crossbow bolts travel in a straight line.
att2.assist.enchantment.200: Longsword Exclusive Enchantment <Sword-Shield Combo>: While blocking with a shield, press Sneak + Right Click to unleash a sword skill followed by three extra large AoE slashes, each dealing (40%/60%/80%) bonus damage.
att2.assist.enchantment.202: Longsword Exclusive Enchantment <Sword of Stone>: Transforms into a new powerful enchant after killing 5 different mutated elites, granting strong attribute bonuses.
att2.assist.enchantment.203: Hammer Exclusive Enchantment <Ground Slam>: Jump attacks deal (15%/30%/45%/60%/75%) extra damage and lightly knock back nearby enemies.
att2.assist.enchantment.204: Dagger Exclusive Enchantment <Finishing Blow>: Third consecutive attack on the same target deals (20%/40%/60%/80%/100%) extra damage.
att2.assist.enchantment.205: Dagger Exclusive Enchantment <Backstab>: Sneak while aiming at an enemy to teleport behind them. The next (1/2/3) attacks are faster and grant 1.5 seconds of invulnerability.
att2.assist.enchantment.206: Axe Exclusive Enchantment <Armor Break>: Reduces enemy armor by (4/8/12/16/20) points and lowers Protection enchant by (1/2/3/4/5) levels for (2/4/6/8/10) seconds.
att2.assist.enchantment.207: Axe Exclusive Enchantment <Thousand Slayer>: Each kill increases base weapon damage by +0.2 and reduces maximum health by -0.02.
att2.assist.enchantment.208: Spear Exclusive Enchantment <Breakthrough>: Sprint attacks that trigger precise spear hits deal extra AoE damage and knockback.
att2.assist.enchantment.209: Spear Exclusive Enchantment <Long Reach>: Increases attack range by (0.4/0.8/1.2).
att2.assist.enchantment.210: Scythe Exclusive Enchantment <Bloodreaver>: Striking weak points deals (5%/10%/15%/20%/25%) extra damage and heals for half the bonus damage dealt.
att2.assist.enchantment.211: Helmet Exclusive Enchantment <Empathy>:Daytime: Strength (0/-1/-1/-2), Movement Speed (0/-1/-1/-2).Nighttime: Strength (+1/+2/+3/+4), Movement Speed (+1/+2/+3/+4).
att2.assist.enchantment.212: Helmet Exclusive Enchantment <Dahäl Drain>: Maximum Dahäl (+10%/+20%/+30%/+40%/+50%); Maximum Health (-10%/-20%/-30%/-40%/-50%).
att2.assist.enchantment.213: Helmet Exclusive Enchantment <Alchemy Master>: Positive potion effect duration (+20%/+40%/+60%/+80%/+100%).
att2.assist.enchantment.214: Helmet Exclusive Enchantment <Gourmet Master>: Every three different foods eaten grant extra Health Regeneration and Hunger Resistance. Eating the same food consecutively drastically reduces Hunger Resistance.
att2.assist.enchantment.215: Chestplate Exclusive Enchantment <Heart Protection>: When health falls below (10%/20%/30%), fully restore health and knock back nearby enemies. This enchant is then removed (one-time use only).
att2.assist.enchantment.216: Chestplate Exclusive Enchantment <Dahäl Burst>: Hold Dahäl Catalyst and press Sneak; consume (10%/20%/30%/40%/50%) Dahäl to boost the next damaging spell by (10%/20%/30%/40%/50%).
att2.assist.enchantment.217: Chestplate Exclusive Enchantment <Selfless Aid>: 50% chance per second to consume 1 armor point; Health Regeneration (+1/+2/+3/+4/+5).
att2.assist.enchantment.218: Chestplate Exclusive Enchantment <Wrath Accumulator>: Accumulate damage taken. Upon reaching 150 accumulated damage, deal (165/180/195/210/225) damage to nearby enemies and gain (0.5/1/1.5/2/2.5) seconds of invulnerability.
att2.assist.enchantment.219: Leggings Exclusive Enchantment <Swift Sneak>: Sneak speed (+0.2/+0.4/+0.6).
att2.assist.enchantment.220: Leggings Exclusive Enchantment <Spell Overload>: While holding Dahäl Catalyst in main or off-hand; Dahäl Regeneration (+1/+2/+3).
att2.assist.enchantment.221: Leggings Exclusive Enchantment <Treasure Hunter>: Opening chests stacks 1 Treasure Level. At 7 stacks, gain (1/2/3) Gold Rush levels, greatly boosting Luck when opening chests.
att2.assist.enchantment.222: Boots Exclusive Enchantment <Easy Walk>: Allows easy stepping over 1-block high obstacles.
att2.assist.enchantment.223: Boots Exclusive Enchantment <Blazing Speed>: Sprinting grants +(1/2/3) Movement Speed but greatly increases hunger drain.
att2.assist.enchantment.224: Boots Exclusive Enchantment <Thousand-Mile Stride>: Reduces hunger drain while sprinting.
att2.assist.enchantment.225: Boots Exclusive Enchantment <Abyss Explorer>: Greatly increases swimming speed.
att2.assist.enchantment.226: Boots Exclusive Enchantment <Rapid Cooldown>: 40% chance per second to lose 1 health; Spell Cooldown Haste (+10/+20/+30/+40/+50).
att2.assist.temperature.227: Body temperature changes with the environment, weather and player actions. Low temperature triggers Chill penalties; high temperature triggers Overheat penalties.
att2.assist.temperature.228: To reduce prolonged overheating, swim in water, drink potions or remove armor.
att2.assist.temperature.229: To raise prolonged low temperature, wear leather armor, sprint or cast fire spells.
att2.assist.temperature.230: Maintaining a suitable temperature grants slight boosts to Movement Speed and Attack Speed.
att2.assist.fishing.231: <Fishing spots> show up on the water as a ring of particles. Cast your bobber within 3 blocks of the ring to fish there. <Fishing gear> is sold by the fishermen in every city.
att2.assist.fishing.232: The ring's colour shows the spot's <quality>: grey (1-4), green (5-7), blue (8-10), purple (11-13), orange (14-16), then bright green (17+). The higher it is, the more loot a catch yields.
att2.assist.fishing.233: Throw a <Bait> into the ring (right-click) to raise its quality. A better bait adds more and reaches higher: common +3 (max 6), uncommon +4 (max 9), rare +5 (max 12), epic +6 (max 15), legendary +7 and ultimate +8 (max 20).
att2.assist.fishing.234: A bait does not last forever: it grants one charge (3 at most), and every catch spends a charge and lowers the quality by 2. Once the charges run out the spot falls back to quality 1. Throw another bait to restart it.
att2.assist.fishing.235: The spot's <region> decides which rarities can be caught: between the first zone and the last, the odds of epic, legendary and mythic items are several hundred times higher. Quality raises the <amount>, the region raises the <rarity>.
att2.assist.fishing.236: <Luck> adds — or removes, when negative — rolls of Chronotons, equipment and runes on every catch. Consumables are not affected.
att2.assist.fishing.237: Place a <Small chair> and sit on it: no monster spawns within 30 blocks while you stay seated. Ideal for fishing in peace.
